title: mutateStateBatch afterMutation callback runs before commit
description: Correctness review finding. In packages/core/src/state/mutateState.ts mutateStateBatch wraps the loop in withTransaction and invokes afterMutation inside that transaction, so the callback observes writes that are not yet durable and that a later batch failure rolls back. The contract implied by the name is misleading. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: afterMutation runs after the batch transaction commits, or its pre-commit semantics are documented; tests cover the rollback case.
